ops.title: Make CCI grep scan work proportional to records
ops.description: Owner: cci_grep_hotpath. Evidence: installed v0.41.6 cci grep REVIEW --drive durable-agents-rebuild sampled ~18 seconds at 88% CPU; existing Grep pages a descending full-record query. Next: trace actual v0.41.6 query plan and implement semantics-preserving query path, with CI proving N32/10000 actual-caller operation counts. Preserve protected sessions; no local tests/builds/benchmarks. Root serializes local installation.

ops.text: Exact whole-line regex, ordering, filter, limit, budget and JSON behavior retained with regression coverage
CI actual-caller N32 and 10000-record operation counts demonstrate removal of repeated full scans/exports
Independent review and CI pass on merged commit; signed release and root installation followed by affected-call verification
